knownOpenGaps.desc: No virus/malware scanning on object storage uploads
No field-level encryption for PII columns
Firebase & Google credentials require manual rotation
80+ env vars with no formal schema documentation
No Lighthouse CI performance regression guard
Large vendor bundle sizes on all web apps (1-1.7 MB)
